components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary action within a decision cluster.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: #1A73E8; color: #FFFFFF; font: 700 0.78rem/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1765C1; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1A73E8; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.58; cursor: not-allowed; transform: none; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A reversible or supporting action that stays visually subordinate.

components.name: Workflow Filter
components.description: A compact workflow filter with an inherited count state.
components.css: .ds-filter { min-height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid #1A73E8; border-radius: 999px; background: #1A73E8; color: #FFFFFF; font: 700 0.78rem/1 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-filter strong { min-width: 18px; padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.22); font-size: 0.72rem; } .ds-filter:hover { background: #1765C1; } .ds-filter:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-filter:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1A73E8; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Operational Field
components.description: A readable field for filters, dates, notes, and operational values.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #334155; font: 700 0.78rem/1.2 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #CBD5E1; border-radius: 10px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #0F172A; font: 400 0.95rem/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #64748B; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: #94A3B8; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1A73E8; outline-offset: 1px; border-color: #1A73E8; } .ds-field input:disabled { background: #F1F5F9; color: #64748B; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Mobile Workflow Dock
components.description: Five complete workflow destinations within the constrained Shopify Admin viewport.
components.css: .ds-mobile-dock { width: min(100%, 340px); display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(5, minmax(0,1fr)); gap: 4px; padding: 5px 7px; border: 1px solid rgba(203,213,225,0.9); border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.94); box-shadow: 0 8px 18px rgba(15,23,42,0.14); font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-mobile-dock button { min-width: 0; min-height: 44px; display: grid; place-items: center; gap: 2px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #334155; cursor: pointer; } .ds-mobile-dock button span { width: 26px; height: 26px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 800; } .ds-mobile-dock button small { font-size: 0.68rem; } .ds-mobile-dock button.is-active span { background: #DBEAFE; color: #1765C1; } .ds-mobile-dock button:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-mobile-dock button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1A73E8; outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Workflow Segmented Control
components.description: A compact switch between adjacent production states.
components.css: .ds-segments { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; border: 1px solid #CBD5E1; border-radius: 999px; background: #F8FAFC; font-family: system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-segments button { min-height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #334155; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-segments button[aria-selected="true"] { background: #1A73E8; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-segments button span { min-width: 18px; padding: 2px 5px; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(15,23,42,0.08); font-size: 0.72rem; } .ds-segments button[aria-selected="true"] span { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.22); } .ds-segments button:hover { background: #EFF6FF; color: #1765C1; } .ds-segments button[aria-selected="true"]:hover { background: #1765C1; color: #FFFFFF; } .ds-segments button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #1A73E8; outline-offset: 1px; }

narrative.overview: The interface should feel like a well-organized production surface: every tool and piece of order information has a clear place, the next action is visible, and nothing competes for attention without an operational reason. The visual register is restrained and work-focused, using a white and slate foundation with Action Blue reserved for active state and primary action. Density is allowed because this is a real shop tool, but structure must do the work. Desktop and mobile are two complete arrangements of the same workflow; mobile is not a reduced companion.
keyCharacteristics: Clear state, urgency, and action hierarchy
Complete capability across desktop and Shopify Admin mobile viewports
Modular enough to accept new stages without losing coherence

rules.name: The One Active Signal Rule
rules.body: Action Blue marks what is active or what should happen next; it is forbidden as ambient decoration.

rules.name: The Status Must Mean Something Rule
rules.body: Green, umber, and red appear only when the underlying order state justifies them, and every state also has a text or icon cue.

rules.name: The Scan Before Read Rule
rules.body: Order number, customer, status, blocker, and next action must be distinguishable before the user reads supporting detail.

rules.name: The No Decorative Type Rule
rules.body: Display fonts, excessive tracking, and oversized fluid headings are forbidden in this task surface.

rules.name: The Structural Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow must explain stacking or movement. Never pair a one-pixel decorative border with a wide soft shadow on an ordinary card or button.

rules.name: The One Floating Layer Rule
rules.body: Translucency and backdrop blur are reserved for the compact mobile dock; they must not spread to panels or cards.

dos: Do use Action Blue only for the current state, focus, selection, and the primary action in a decision cluster.
Do use the 4px micro-step and the 8px, 12px, and 16px rhythm to keep dense layouts orderly.
Do preserve the complete workflow on desktop and mobile, including mockups, batching, production detail, and stage changes.
Do maintain at least 44 by 44 CSS-pixel touch targets, visible focus, and WCAG 2.2 AA contrast.
Do provide immediate feedback for state changes and a safe recovery path wherever practical.
Do extend the interface through the existing workflow model when new stages or shop operations are added.
donts: Don't use generic dashboard conventions that are disconnected from PrintMO's real workflow.
Don't allow visual density to become noisy or overwhelming; remove or progressively disclose information that is not needed for the current task.
Don't accumulate new capabilities as unrelated panels or generic cards; connect them to the order-production sequence.
Don't reduce mobile to a read-only or feature-limited companion, or assume a full-screen mobile browser outside Shopify Admin.
Don't use gradient text, decorative side-stripe borders, repeating stripe or grid backgrounds, or decorative glass panels.
Don't combine one-pixel borders with wide soft shadows, use card radii above 25px, or animate layout properties for decoration.
Don't use color as the only status cue or hide secondary text with low contrast.
